title: Reactive Programming
content: Reactive programming is a programming paradigm focused on data flows and the propagation of changes. Libraries like RxJS for JavaScript and Reactor for Java enable reactive development.

title: Functional Programming
content: Functional programming treats computation as the evaluation of mathematical functions. Languages like Haskell, Lisp, and modern JavaScript support functional programming principles.

title: Object-Oriented Design
content: Object-oriented design principles include encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Design patterns provide reusable solutions to common programming problems.

title: Microservices Architecture
content: Microservices break applications into small loosely coupled services. This architecture enables independent deployment and scaling of individual services.

title: Container Technology
content: Containers package applications with their dependencies for consistent deployment. Docker is the most popular containerization platform.

title: Kubernetes Orchestration
content: Kubernetes automates deployment and management of containerized applications. It handles scaling, updates, and service discovery automatically.

title: GraphQL API Design
content: GraphQL is a query language for APIs that allows clients to request exactly the data they need. It provides advantages over REST APIs in flexibility and efficiency.

title: REST API Best Practices
content: REST APIs use HTTP methods and status codes to create scalable web services. Proper design improves API usability and maintainability.

title: Event-Driven Architecture
content: Event-driven systems respond to events using asynchronous communication. Message queues and event streams enable loose coupling between components.

title: NoSQL Databases
content: NoSQL databases like MongoDB and Cassandra provide flexible data models. They are designed for horizontal scaling and high availability.

title: Authentication Methods
content: Authentication verifies user identity using passwords, tokens, or biometrics. OAuth 2.0 and JWT are popular for modern applications.

title: Data Encryption
content: Encryption protects data using mathematical algorithms. AES for symmetric encryption and RSA for asymmetric encryption are industry standards.

title: Network Security
content: Network security involves firewalls, intrusion detection, and VPNs. Layered security approaches provide defense in depth.

title: Web Performance
content: Web performance optimization includes minification, caching, and lazy loading. Faster websites improve user experience and SEO rankings.

title: Responsive Design
content: Responsive web design adapts to different screen sizes using flexible layouts and media queries. Mobile-first design is now the standard.
